subject: MAP Draft: Data handling, retention & audit requirements (next steps)
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Claire Johnson <claire.johnson@medisyshealth.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@medisyshealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-02T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: MAP Draft: Data handling, retention & audit requirements (next steps)

Hi Claire / Samir,

Thanks again for the call earlier — appreciate the clarity on your integration pattern and PHI surface. Per our discussion I attached a first-pass MAP that isolates the data-handling milestones you asked about. Key takeaway summary below and a proposed owner/timeline for each milestone.

Quick summary (from the call):
- Scope: inference-only calls from your frontend to Redwood Hosted API for non-critical patient identifiers; some workflows will require Private deployment due to full PHI payloads.
- Primary compliance ask: 90-day retention for logs, immutable audit trails for admin actions, and ability to redact PHI on demand.
- Evidence: SOC 2 + willingness to discuss BAA for Private deployment.

Proposed MAP milestones (high-level):
1) Scope confirmation (owner: MediSys, target: 2026-07-09) — final list of endpoints & PHI fields
2) Deployment model decision (owner: Karthik / Sales Eng, target: 2026-07-12) — Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private (BAA requirement)
3) Retention & logging policy (owner: MediSys / Security, target: 2026-07-16) — retention windows, log access control, export process
4) Audit trail & redaction playbook (owner: Redwood SecEng, target: 2026-07-23) — admin audit logs, WORM/archive options, redaction API
5) Compliance evidence handoff (owner: Karthik, target: 2026-07-28) — SOC2 report, architecture diagrams, sample logs

Attachments: RDW_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet with milestone table), redwood_security_factsheet.pdf (controls & certs).

Action items for Claire / Samir:
- Confirm owners for items 1 and 3 by 2026-07-09.
- Indicate whether MediSys requires a BAA (yes/no) so we can include Private deployment pricing if needed.

I'll follow up with a short technical appendix (Monica will draft) that lists the exact log fields we capture by default.

Best,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

---

From: Claire Johnson <claire.johnson@medisyshealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@medisyshealth.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-03T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP Draft: Data handling, retention & audit requirements (next steps)

Thanks, Karthik — this is very helpful. Quick responses inline: 

- Owners: I will take item 1 (scope confirmation). Samir will own item 3 (retention & logging policy) and loop in our security team.
- BAA: We do need a BAA for any deployment that will persist PHI or allow admins to view full payloads.
- Retention: Our legal wants a default 30-day retention for full request bodies, but 365 days for token-level telemetry—open to Redwood options if we can redact PD/PII on demand.
- Audit: We need immutable audit logs for all admin actions and the ability to export them monthly for our internal auditors.

One clarifying Q: for Hosted API, is on-the-fly redaction available or would that require Private? Also we need to confirm whether your logs include the full prompt text by default — if so we will require prompt redaction at ingest.

Can Monica or Karthik provide the list of log fields and a sample anonymized log snippet?

Claire Johnson
Head of Product Security | MediSys Health
claire.johnson@medisyshealth.com

---

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Claire Johnson <claire.johnson@medisyshealth.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-06T11:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP Draft: Data handling, retention & audit requirements (next steps)

Claire — thanks for the quick turn. Short answers below, plus I attached a short "log-field matrix" in the RDW_MAP_v1.xlsx sheet named "Logs".

- Hosted redaction: Hosted API supports token-level telemetry and can be configured to drop request bodies from logs, but on-the-fly redaction of PHI in payloads is not offered as a managed feature on Hosted unless you add a middleware scrubbing layer on your side or choose Private (we can offer a redaction pipeline as part of Private deployment).
- Logs: by default Hosted logs capture request_id, timestamp, route, model, token_count, and a limited excerpt of the prompt (first 200 chars) for debugging. Full prompt text is only retained when customers enable debug-logging.
- Options: we can support a 30-day default for full request bodies and 365-day token telemetry as a configuration in Dedicated or Private. For Hosted we can set debug off by default and enable on a per-incident basis (audited).

Attached sample (anonymized):
- sample_log_20260706.txt (redacted prompt: "[REDACTED]"), fields: request_id, ts, route, model, token_count, status, response_time_ms, redaction_flag

Proposed next steps:
- Samir / MediSys to confirm BAA requirement (Claire flagged yes) — if yes, we move to Private pricing & legal (target: 2026-07-12).
- Redwood to produce an audit-playbook draft (Monica lead) with redaction API spec by 2026-07-16.

I'll put the sample log and the sheet in the Drive link and update the MAP spreadsheet accordingly.

Thanks,
Monica
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com

Attachments: sample_log_20260706.txt (text/plain)

---

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@medisyshealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Claire Johnson <claire.johnson@medisyshealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-08T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP Draft: Data handling, retention & audit requirements (next steps)

Looping back from security: we confirm the following and propose minor adjustments to the MAP timeline. See inline.

- BAA: Required for any environment retaining PHI. MediSys prefers Private with BAA.
- Retention windows: Accept Redwood's config options. We want the default full-body retention set to 30 days; token telemetry at 365 days.
- Audit export: monthly exports in CSV for our internal archive, plus S3 push with versioned objects.
- Redaction: Must support on-demand redaction of specific request_ids (legal hold & DSAR support) with an API or portal.

Timeline updates:
- Scope confirmation moved to 2026-07-11 (owner: Claire)
- Deployment decision to 2026-07-14 (owner: Karthik / Monica)
- Retention policy sign-off to 2026-07-20 (owner: Samir / MediSys Sec)
- Audit playbook draft to 2026-07-20 (owner: Monica)

Next steps for Redwood:
1) Provide Private deployment pricing + BAA template (Karthik) — due 2026-07-10
2) Monica to deliver the log-field matrix + anonymized sample (done) and a short draft of the redaction API contract (due 2026-07-16)
3) Karthik to coordinate legal for a BAA and share with MediSys (due 2026-07-12)

I can arrange a 30-minute follow-up call next week to finalize.

Thanks,
Samir
Senior Security Program Manager | MediSys Health
samir.patel@medisyshealth.com
